title: Jarvis Switch settings
description: ~/.config/jarvis-switch/config.json. Every field is optional; empty fields are detected from OpenClaw. The app re-reads the file within one refresh, so no restart is needed. Never put tokens or API keys here: the app does not need them.

$schema.description: Link to this schema, for editors and agents.

name.description: The assistant's name shown in the menu bar and panel.

refreshSeconds.description: How often the status refreshes. 1 = live (speed, context and memory every second). Scheduled jobs are read at most every 30 seconds whatever this is.

menuBarText.description: Show the state as a word (Idle, Working, Paused…) next to the menu-bar icon.

checkForUpdates.description: Check GitHub releases once a day and show a banner when a newer version exists.

openclawConfig.description: Path to OpenClaw's config file. Default: $OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH, then ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json. Used for the gateway port and the default model's server address.

metricsDir.description: Optional assistant directory containing logs/run_metrics.jsonl (plus optional eval_history.jsonl, cleanup_receipts.jsonl, and state/cleanup_registry.json). Defaults to the folder containing openclawConfig. The Learning & Hygiene card stays hidden unless logs/run_metrics.jsonl exists.

openclawCLI.description: Path to the openclaw command (or a wrapper script that sets OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR / OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH). Default: ~/.openclaw/bin/openclaw, then Homebrew paths. Used for scheduled jobs and the session store.

gatewayURL.description: OpenClaw gateway address. Default: http://127.0.0.1:<gateway.port from openclaw.json>, else http://127.0.0.1:18789.

modelBaseURL.description: Model server address. Default: the baseUrl of the provider behind agents.defaults.model in openclaw.json. Splash, LM Studio, Ollama and OpenAI-compatible servers are recognised.

dashboardCommand.description: What "Open OpenClaw" runs (argv, no shell). Default: [openclaw, "dashboard"].

offload.description: Pause / Resume buttons. Each command is an argv list run without a shell. Leave out to hide the Pause section.

light.description: Light pause: free the model's memory but keep the server, e.g. unload the weights.

deep.description: Deep pause: stop the model server to free the most memory.

stateFile.description: File that exists while paused (optional JSON with "mode" and "purpose"). If left out, the app keeps its own marker at ~/.config/jarvis-switch/paused.json.

lightLabel.description: Hover hint for the Light button.

deepLabel.description: Hover hint for the Deep button.
